blocks.html:
This method generates a reset password token for a user. It sends a request to the
Generate Reset Password Token for a User API route.

Useful for constructing the reset password link without sending an email.

The token is short-lived, can only be used once, and generating it invalidates
any reset password token previously issued for the user.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the user to generate the token for.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: token
children.description:
The generated reset password token. Append it to the admin's
`/reset-password` page as a `token` query parameter to build a link the
user can open to set a new password.

The token is short-lived, can only be used once, and generating it
invalidates any reset password token previously issued for the user.
